2026_01_BAL_IND.headline: Baltimore’s missing interior disruptor gives Indianapolis a cleaner protection test
2026_01_BAL_IND.paragraph1: Baltimore will open without defensive tackle Nnamdi Madubuike, removing a major interior pressure piece as Indianapolis brings Daniel Jones back from his Achilles recovery. The Colts enter without anyone ruled out, and Alec Pierce worked back to full participation after a heel issue. Baltimore still has Lamar Jackson’s movement and explosive-play creation to stress every level of the defense. Indianapolis’ best path is to stay on schedule, protect the pocket and keep Jackson from turning broken downs into drive-extending gains.
2026_01_BAL_IND.model_rationale: Baltimore carries the higher quarterback-driven ceiling, while Indianapolis can keep the game compressed by protecting Jones, winning early downs and limiting Jackson’s off-script explosives.
